levels.name: Courtyard
levels.objective: Collect 3 intel, then reach EXFIL at (38, -38)

levels.name: Ballroom
levels.note: One physical room across 3 pages; only the mission and player logic differ.
levels.objective: Photograph the 3 cats (Moxie, Mabel, Margo); the door code is moon, note, rose

levels.name: Theater
levels.objective: Rochelle defeats 8 enemies; 3 sword hits each

levels.name: Halloween
levels.note: Residential street, fixed sniper nest at the south end; the player does not walk.
levels.objective: Stop 5 terrorists from the sniper nest; shooting a civilian fails the mission

levels.name: Mall
levels.note: Two stories: ground floor y=0, upper floor y=4.5 around the central atrium.
levels.objective: Defuse 4 C4 in 5:00; shooting a shopper fails the mission

levels.name: Viewer
levels.objective: Inspect models, animations and weapon offsets

note: The real levels of Undercover: Double Agent. Dimensions are the game's own room sizes, measured from the level pages. 'editor' gives the working size the stage editor uses for its shell: the theater shell covers the stage and front house (the full room is deeper), the ballroom shell's ceiling is the editor's own framing, and the courtyard shell is open sky above the 4 m perimeter walls.
